bio_en: Tigran Amseian, known as Tsamhur and by the alias Ferit Jemil, was shaped at the Sanasarian school in Karin (1905) and drawn into revolutionary work by Dr Zavriev; he became a correspondent of the Tiflis 'Haraj' and linked up with Turkish activists behind the 1906 Karin demonstrations. During the 1909 Cilician massacres he was wounded by a bomb in Aintab and imprisoned. Deported with the Constantinople intellectuals on 23 April 1915, he survived by working under false names along the Baghdad railway. He fell on the barricade in 1921, shot while fighting the Bolsheviks.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Text says '95 April 23' for the 1915 deportation - a misprint.
